note: Newly remodeled Shoshone NF campground in conifers beside Fox Creek on the Beartooth Highway (US 212), about 5 mi W of the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway junction and ~7 mi E of Cooke City, MT, with views of Pilot and Index Peaks. Trailheads into the Absaroka and Beartooth ranges nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page: 33 sites (all electric: singles + two triple sites), FCFS (no rec.gov listing), $30 electric single / $90 triple, cash or check, 16-day limit, 32-ft spurs, vault toilets + potable water + bear boxes, late June to early/mid September. Amperage unpublished (hookups not written). Website dead -> new FS URL. Not waterfront confirmed.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: the nearest loop end (~44.9765,-109.8318) is ~30-60 m from the creek's gravel wash through a continuous conifer band; the flowing channel is narrow (~5-10 m).
Pin 44.9763,-109.8329 is inside the camp loops (matches FS point 44.97628,-109.83293). No move.
History: closed in 2019 and 2022 for Beartooth Highway construction (third-party listings); FS page shows only a seasonal close for 2026.
